{{TierBar}}


'''Preeminent Parasites''' are a Tier of [[Mobs#Parasites|Parasites]]. This Tier is almost at the top of the Hierarchy, excluding the deprecated [[Ancient Parasites]], and contains 7 Mobs. 

Preeminent Parasites are some of the most dangerous Parasites the Player will likely encounter.

== ''Shared Aspects and Capabilities'' ==

=== Spawning ===
*Spawns naturally when a [[Colony]] with a certain number of Points exists in the dimension.
*Spawned inside the [[Parasite Biome]].

=== Weakness ===
*Like all Parasites, Preeminents present a weakness to fire (damage inflicted by fire is quadrupled);
*Some of the Preeminent Parasites present a [[Adaptation System#Trivia|Weak Point]]: 
**When [[Adaptation System#Trivia|Weak Points]] are hit, the damage inflicted to the Parasite is tripled. This also inflicts the [[Bleeding]] Effect to the Parasite;

=== Combat Capabilities ===
To be added...

=== Post-Death ===
*After dying, all Preeminents have a chance to explode, releasing a Potion Cloud which inflicts the Poison and [[Call Of The Hive]] Effects. They will also leave behind [[Remains|Preeminent Remains]];
*After dying, all Preeminents have a chance to activate the [[Reinforcement System]].
